---
title: "Locus Table"
subtitle: "A summary by locus: best gene, mecanism, cell type, context."
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(data.table); library(stringr); library(DT)
THR <- 0.8

d <- fread("data/coloc_all_annotated.csv")
d[is.na(gene_symbol) | gene_symbol == "", gene_symbol := gene_clean]
d[, gene_symbol := str_remove(as.character(gene_symbol), ";.*$")]
d[, family := fcase(
  str_detect(dataset, regex("^gtex_", ignore_case = TRUE)),        "GTEx",
  str_detect(dataset, regex("^bigbrain_", ignore_case = TRUE)),    "BigBrain",
  str_detect(dataset, regex("^devbrain_", ignore_case = TRUE)),    "DevBrain",
  str_detect(dataset, regex("^singlebrain_", ignore_case = TRUE)), "SingleBrain",
  default = "Outro")]
d[, mod := fifelse(str_detect(dataset, regex("_sqtl$", ignore_case = TRUE)), "sQTL", "eQTL")]

sig <- d[PP.H4 > THR]

top <- sig[order(-PP.H4), .SD[1], by = locus][, .(locus, top_gene = gene_symbol, top_pp4 = round(PP.H4,3), top_dataset = dataset)]
resumo <- sig[, .(
  n_genes = uniqueN(gene_symbol),
  n_datasets = uniqueN(dataset),
  mecanism = fifelse(uniqueN(mod) > 1, "eQTL + sQTL", mod[1]),
  cell_type = fifelse(any(family == "SingleBrain"), "Sim", "Não"),
  development = fifelse(any(family == "DevBrain"), "Sim", "Não")
), by = locus]

tab <- merge(top, resumo, by = "locus")
setorder(tab, -top_pp4)

datatable(tab, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", extensions = "Buttons",
          options = list(pageLength = 20, dom = "Bfrtip", buttons = c("copy","csv"), scrollX = TRUE))
```
